value.rationale: The matrix is a minimal hypocoercive benchmark appearing in the primary literature. The theorem gives full exact step-size-safe classifications for three standard methods and a strict counterintuitive 19% RK3-over-RK4 advantage (with fewer stages), plus a rational instance of spectral stability without monotone energy. Such sharp method-choice information is not merely renaming or numerical enumeration; the result is restricted and does not suggest universal accuracy superiority.
